caller_file.description: Absolute path to the caller's Java source file

caller_type.description: Simple name of the class that delegates to the service (e.g. CallerService)

caller_method.description: Name of the method being extracted into the service boundary (e.g. processOrder)

caller_method_parameter_types.description: Written parameter types for disambiguation (e.g. ["String"] or [])

method_contract.description: Complete abstract method declaration for the interface body, including semicolon (e.g. "void processOrder(String orderId);")

method_signature.description: Method signature for the implementation — without semicolon and without visibility modifier (e.g. "void processOrder(String orderId)")

implementation_body.description: Statements for the implementation method body (no surrounding braces). Empty string triggers error.behavior_move_unsupported.

caller_replacement.description: Statements that replace the caller's extracted method body, delegating to the injected service field (no surrounding braces)

service_name.description: Base service name (e.g. Inventory); interface becomes <name>Service, implementation becomes <name>ServiceImpl

service_package.description: Java package for the new service interface and implementation (e.g. com.example)

service_source_root.description: Absolute path to the Java source root where service files are emitted (e.g. /repo/src/main/java)

service_field_name.description: Field name for the injected service reference in the caller (e.g. inventoryService)

guice_module_file.description: Absolute path to the Guice AbstractModule source file

guice_module_type.description: Simple name of the Guice AbstractModule class (e.g. AppModule)

probes.name: caller_method_probe
probes.description: Locates the target method by name scoped to the caller file; count=0 → not found, count>1 → genuine overloads in the same file

probes.name: service_type_exists
probes.description: Checks whether the service interface already exists (idempotency guard)

probes.name: impl_type_exists
probes.description: Checks whether the service implementation class already exists (idempotency guard)

probes.name: guice_module
probes.description: Locates the Guice module class scoped to the supplied module file; count=0 → not found, count>1 → ambiguous

refusals.message: Method '${inputs.caller_method}' was not found in the project; confirm caller_type and caller_method are correct and the source is indexed
Method '${inputs.caller_method}' matches more than one symbol; provide caller_method_parameter_types to disambiguate or rename the method before extracting
A type named '${inputs.service_name}Service' already exists in the project; delete it first or choose a different service_name
A type named '${inputs.service_name}ServiceImpl' already exists in the project; delete it first or choose a different service_name
Guice module '${inputs.guice_module_type}' was not found; confirm guice_module_type and guice_module_file are correct
More than one type matches '${inputs.guice_module_type}'; qualify guice_module_type or rename the module to avoid ambiguity
implementation_body is empty; provide the extracted method body statements or set implementation_body to a non-empty stub before applying this macro

operations.label: verify_compilation
operations.body: Service boundary applied: ${inputs.service_name}Service interface + ${inputs.service_name}ServiceImpl created, ${inputs.caller_type}.${inputs.caller_method} delegates via injected field '${inputs.service_field_name}'. Verify the project compiles and add any missing imports in the caller file.
